{{Term/Store|Stamina Recovery||Series, TotK}},{{Exp Game|TotK}}<ref>{{Cite Guide|TotK Piggyback|page= 439}}</ref> also known as {{Term/Store|Stamina Restoration||BotW}}{{Exp Game|BotW}}<ref>{{Cite Guide|BotW Piggyback|page= 280}}</ref> is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}.

==Overview==
{{Stub}}<!-- Could use data about how much each ingredient restores, based on wheel fifths.-->
Stamina Recovery is an [[Added Effect]] that restores [[Link]]'s [[Stamina]]. The amount of Stamina restored depends on the [[Ingredients]] used to create the [[Meal]] or [[Elixir]].

==={{BotW|-}}===
These [[Material]]s grant Stamina Restoration in {{BotW}}:
* [[Stamella Shroom]]
* [[Courser Bee Honey]]
* [[Staminoka Bass]]
* [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]
* [[Energetic Rhino Beetle]]
* [[Restless Cricket]]

==={{TotK|-}}===
In {{TotK}}, the following [[Material]]s impart Stamina Recovery:
* [[Stamella Shroom]]
* [[Stambulb]]
* [[Courser Bee Honey]]
* [[Staminoka Bass]]
* [[Bright-Eyed Crab]]
* [[Energetic Rhino Beetle]]
* [[Restless Cricket]]
